support.title: Support
support.lead: Understand BatterVibe’s release status, power readings, display controls, closed-lid support and purchase plans.
support.contactIntro: Please include your Mac model, macOS version, app version, installation channel and a description of what you see.
faqs: Can I download or try the new release now?

Not yet. The version currently submitted for review is the earlier battery monitor. BatterVibe’s display controls, dedicated control panel, Apple trial and one-time purchase are in development. The website will link to the new release when it is available.
How do the menu bar and control panel differ?

The menu bar provides a quick battery or power reading. The dedicated panel brings together feature explanations, purchase status and restoration, and a thank-you for your support. Individual features are operated through their respective in-app entry points.
Why is net battery power negative when plugged in?

Net battery power is input minus system usage. When your Mac uses more than the adapter supplies, the battery makes up the difference. Adapter wattage and live DC input are separate readings. A dash means that a reading is unavailable.
Can every Mac use the HDR brightness boost?

No. HDR boost depends on display capability. It has been verified on the built-in XDR display of MacBook Pro (Mac14,6); other models await verification. Unsupported devices are not promised a boost. Increased brightness may also use more power.
Which installation channels support closed-lid operation?

Closed-lid operation requires the website installation’s background component and system authorization. Mac App Store support is still being verified. Check the capabilities of your installed release and leave the Mac on a ventilated, stationary surface.
Will the trial charge me automatically?

No. The initial trial is free for 14 days, after which you choose whether to make a one-time Apple in-app purchase. The planned mainland China price is CNY 6, with no automatic renewal. This flow is in development; local prices will appear in Apple’s purchase screen after release.
How will I restore a purchase after reinstalling?

Restore Purchases is planned for the control panel. Once released, use the Apple account used for the original purchase to restore eligible entitlements. No separate BatterVibe account is planned. Purchases for the new release are not yet open.
Which languages are supported?

Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, French and Spanish. The website’s language menu keeps you on the corresponding page. App language preferences are stored on your Mac.
Can I set a charge limit?

The upcoming release includes a charge-limit entry point for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26.4 or later. With Mac App Store installation, first add the system shortcut as guided, then choose a supported target from the app’s charge-limit entry point. Starting the shortcut does not confirm a change; check the result in the system Battery settings.
Which devices support basic monitoring?

Basic monitoring requires macOS 13 or later and is designed for MacBooks with a built-in battery. Readings vary by model and macOS. Desktop Macs have no battery-specific readings. HDR and closed-lid controls have additional device and installation requirements.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: BatterVibe processes battery and power readings locally without collecting or uploading them. This policy also describes the Apple services planned for the purchase features in development.
privacy.contactIntro: Contact Zhiping Jiang with privacy questions or to request deletion of support correspondence.
sections: BatterVibe reads information provided by macOS and displays it locally without collecting or transmitting battery or power readings. Live readings are processed in memory, with no battery history database. Hardware serial numbers are not retained in the display model or sent to the developer.

Display and language preferences and first-run state are stored locally on your Mac. The app requires no account and includes no advertising, tracking, third-party analytics, or telemetry. It does not read personal documents, contacts, photos, location, camera, or microphone data for its features. Support and privacy links open in your system browser.
Live readings are released when the app exits. Local preferences remain until the app’s data is removed using macOS facilities. The developer has no remote copy of, or access to, your local app data.

If you voluntarily email support, your email address and message are used only to respond and investigate your request. You may request deletion of support correspondence, except information that must be retained by law. Please avoid sending unnecessary personal information.

The planned trial, one-time purchase and purchase restoration use Apple StoreKit. Apple processes payments and purchase records; the app reads the required entitlement status. The developer does not receive payment card details. A purchase or trial does not create a battery history database or require a separate BatterVibe account.

This website embeds no advertising or third-party analytics scripts. Its hosting provider may process ordinary access logs to serve and secure the site. App Store downloads, updates, and Apple’s own data handling are governed by Apple’s policies.
Contact jiangzp.cs@icloud.com for privacy questions or deletion of support correspondence. Changes to this policy will be posted here with an updated effective date.
